claim: The exact GPU payload round-trips a scripted non-default resource dimension and format, scanout binding, cursor hotspot/position, backing metadata, pending damage, and dirty-tile state byte-for-byte; the restored front-buffer pixels have the same CRC-32. Deterministic repeat/literal shadows report raw and encoded sizes plus ratio, bounded decompression, and reject malformed runs. Restore fully validates detached resources and bindings before the single commit point, and a valid bound scanout emits exactly one full repair frame.
